messages:
Sam (Sales): Quick sync — ACME Health wants a bundled POC: Redwood API (hosted) + Optimize add-on + Console seats. They asked for a 6-week POC, $25k committed credit and 20% off bundle. Need deal-desk approval and SE to scope SSO/KMS for the POC.
Ritesh (SE): I can take tech presales. Need to confirm SSO (SAML), KMS (BYOK) compatibility, and any IP/egress constraints. Also will need their security questionnaire answered.
Maria (DealDesk): 20% on $25k is aggressive. What's the expected ARR if POC converts? We need attach-to-commit language and term length.
Sam (Sales): They're mid-market, projected ~$120k ARR if successful. Proposed commit structure: 3-month upfront credit that burns against usage. Dev Console seats = 5, Optimize usage for batching tests.
Elaine (SE): For the KMS ask — hosted supports customer-managed keys but requires a Private or Dedicated path for full BYOK in some cases. If we stay hosted, we can do envelope encryption with our KMS + customer key, but that'll add ~10 business days setup.
Chen (Customer Success): We'll own onboarding. Legal will need DPA and a data retention agreement. Also flag: they asked about log retention and audit logs — we'll need to specify retention windows.
Maria (DealDesk): If we reduce to 15% discount + a one-time $5k pilot credit, deal desk is more comfortable. Need revenue ops signoff and an approval code. Also require a minimum commit clause (non-refundable credit).
Sam (Sales): Can deal desk fast-track? Customer wants contract by next Wed to start onboarding.
Ritesh (SE): Minimal POC runbook (attaching here):
```
POC_RUNBOOK
- Duration: 6 weeks
- Resources: 5 Console seats, Optimize: standard tier, API baseline @ 2 concurrent RPS
- Commit: $25k upfront credit, 3-month attach; pilot credit $5k if approved
- KMS: AES-256 BYOK (hosted envelope + optional Dedicated for full BYOK)
- SSO: SAML 2.0 required
- Network: VPC peering recommended for Dedicated; otherwise IP allowlist
- KPIs: latency p95, cost/token, eval error rate on canonical prompt set
- Deliverables: onboarding checklist, KPI dashboard, post-POC conversion plan
```
Maria (DealDesk): Ok I can approve 15% + $5k pilot credit conditional on: 3-month non-refundable commit, conversion SLA (we track within 90 days), and legal signoff. I'll generate an approval code: DD-2024-437.
Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: Thanks. @ritesh can you confirm BYOK enablement timeframe — customer wants it within 10 business days — and provide the KPI prompt set?
Ritesh (SE): 10 business days is tight but possible if customer has KMS ready and we get their SAML metadata same day. I'll prepare the eval prompt set and deploy a sandbox.
Chen (Customer Success): I'll set up the KPI dashboard and own reporting cadence. Send prompts and sample traffic patterns.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled — creating sandbox project ACME-POC on 2024-06-14 09:00 UTC
Maria (DealDesk): I'll draft the pricing appendix and route to revenue ops + legal. Sam, send LOI and I'll link the approval code.
Sam (Sales): Sending LOI now. Will ping when signed. Thanks team.
